title: LLV-GFL300C: compact classical full-log tables save logarithmic memory

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2N), the one physical LLV-GFL300C compact-classical implementation of proof.md executing the complete virtual.md reference program recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. On EVERY branch charged work is O(2^((1/2)sqrt(n)log2(n)+(1/4)sqrt(n)+2sqrt(n)(log2(n))^(-1/2))), with an absolute constant and exact growth index1/2. Original parameters, caps, partial finishing calls, failed work, all-modulus decoders and finite branch are preserved. The actual smaller classical pools, full field/address decoding, original coherent controls, source moves, initialization and cleanup are charged. The sharper internal time sqrt(n)log2(n)/2+sqrt(n)/4+O(sqrt(n)/logn)+O((logn)^2) has strict eventual slack absorbing all fixed polynomial compilation cost into the exact envelope. All five claims concern this same physical configuration.

For this same physical LLV-GFL300C algorithm, every N,s and EVERY branch, peak allocated CLASSICAL workspace is O(n^3/log2n) bits with an absolute constant and exact growth index0. With ell=max(1,ceil log2n),E=2^ell,J=max(1,ceil(E/ell)), seven fixed classical regions of C*2^(2ceil(log2(n+2)))*J bits each, C=2^48, cover the complete maximum address span. Full vectors use2^20ceil(n/ell) slots of16nE bits; completed two-label roots have a separate2^17n-slot pool of16n bits without E padding. All tuples/input/source/decoder/arithmetic, free/qubit-ID metadata, frames/counters, controller/input/output and UNUSED classical padding count. Section3 proves all fixed capacities and slot reuse, not just live occupancy. These are ordinary classical bits, with no cost transferred to a qubit data bank. Since J=O(n/logn), the complete classical allocation is O(n^3/logn), jointly with full-secret success and all other claims.

For this same physical LLV-GFL300C algorithm, every N,s and EVERY branch, peak quantum allocation is O(n) qubits with an absolute constant and exact growth index0. Original retained phase indices, current coherent search/rank/residue scratch, source/LE/transforms and all failure/cleanup registers fit the fixed O(n) logical pool. The WHOLE pool, unused quantum padding, fair-coin and temporary source wires and allocation overlap count. All large label/table/control records reside in the separately counted ordinary CLASSICAL reservation, not basis-qubit storage. Exact logical-state equivalence preserves the full source and output law, jointly with every other claim.

For this same physical LLV-GFL300C algorithm, every N,s and EVERY branch, all acquired copies number O(2^((1/2)sqrt n)), with an absolute constant and exact growth index1/2. The exact compact-classical compilation makes one physical acquisition per virtual acquisition and no others, preserving every failed, rejected, discarded and aborted request and the original caps. Full virtual8 proves main nCcap+K<=2^(sqrt(n)/2); finite lengths change outside constants. Classical/quantum zero initialization is charged time/storage, not DCP copies. Full-secret success at least1-2^-8 and every resource/error claim hold jointly.

For the same LLV-GFL300C algorithm and configuration of proof.md, the proved fractional error tolerance is epsilon(n) = 0: all Q source copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise, for every N and s, full-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1 - 2^-8 jointly with all four resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted; this is not a proof that greater tolerance is impossible.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
